subject.title: fix(codex): honor timeoutSeconds for dynamic tool calls when timeoutMs is absent

question: Should #100722 be the canonical landing PR for #98864, or should maintainers choose another overlapping timeoutSeconds candidate such as #100800?
rationale: The patch is now focused and source-correct, but the timeoutSeconds grace policy affects dynamic-tool/session behavior and several open PRs propose the same fix.

options.title: Land #100722 as canonical
options.body: Accept the maintainer-reworked shared resolver/handler shape here and close the overlapping #98864 candidate PRs after merge.

options.title: Land #100800 instead
options.body: Use the separate focused candidate if maintainers prefer its branch history, then close this PR as superseded after that merge.

options.title: Request different timeout semantics
options.body: Keep the cluster open if maintainers want a different cap/headroom contract before any candidate lands.
